topics.title: EVM Types, State Variables & Visibilities

topics.title: Function Modifiers & Role-Based Access Control
topics.objective: Enforce invariant execution guards using custom function modifiers and Ownable patterns.

topics.objective: Protect smart contracts against external contract callback vulnerabilities.
